options: The current date and time, unchanged
The date exactly one day ago
An error — TRUNC cannot be applied to dates
Today's date with the time component stripped, i.e. midnight today
questions.explain: TRUNC applied to a date strips any time component, leaving midnight on that date — important before comparing to a date column.

questions.q: In Oracle SQL, what does `TRUNC(SYSDATE) - invoice_date` evaluate to?
options: A plain number — the number of days between the two dates
A date
A text string
An error, since you cannot subtract dates in Oracle
questions.explain: Subtracting one Oracle date from another returns a plain number representing the number of days between them.

questions.q: Why is `ADD_MONTHS` preferred over adding a fixed number of days when you need to shift a date forward by whole months?
options: ADD_MONTHS is faster to type, nothing more
ADD_MONTHS correctly handles month-end edge cases (like different month lengths), which plain day arithmetic does not
ADD_MONTHS can only add days, not months
There is no difference between the two approaches
questions.explain: Months have different lengths, so adding a fixed number of days doesn't reliably land on the same day next month — ADD_MONTHS handles this correctly.

questions.q: What is `dual` in `SELECT SYSDATE FROM dual;`?
options: A financial transaction table
A synonym for ap_invoices_all
A tiny built-in Oracle table with exactly one row, used to evaluate expressions without querying real data
A reserved keyword with no table behind it
questions.explain: DUAL is Oracle's built-in single-row table, commonly used to select expressions like SYSDATE that don't depend on any real table.

questions.q: Why should you always supply an explicit format mask with `TO_DATE`, such as `TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`?
options: Relying on Oracle's default date format can behave differently depending on server configuration, silently breaking the query
Format masks are optional and never affect results
TO_DATE requires no arguments other than the text string
Format masks only apply to TO_CHAR, never to TO_DATE
questions.explain: Without an explicit format mask, TO_DATE relies on the session's default date format, which can vary by server — an explicit mask makes the parsing unambiguous.
